# Ishwar Sahani

> Ishwar Sahani (also known as Ishwar Kumar) is a Frontend Developer based in Gurugram, India, specializing in Next.js, React, Node.js, and full-stack MERN/PERN development. He works full-time as a Frontend Developer at a startup.

Ishwar Sahani is a Frontend Developer in Gurugram, Haryana, India. He currently works full-time as a Frontend Developer at Klakar (an artist network). Previously, he worked on map-based video discovery and responsive video interfaces at Dizivizi (a video-location platform). He is open to full-time frontend engineering opportunities.

He holds a B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering and has experience owning frontend features end-to-end in a fast-moving startup environment, translating product requirements into responsive, accessible, and production-ready interfaces.

## Professional Experience

### Klakar — Frontend Developer (2025 — Present, Gurugram, India)

Building the frontend of Klakar, a startup platform where creative professionals build standout portfolios, find collaborators, learn from working pros, and let AI handle the busywork. Working as a full-time Frontend Developer in a startup environment, owning UI implementation end-to-end across product surfaces.

- Own and ship frontend features for Klakar's artist network product using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
- Translate product requirements and Figma designs into responsive, accessible, and production-ready UI components with Tailwind CSS.
- Collaborate directly with founders and backend engineers to integrate APIs, shape product flows, and unblock delivery on tight startup timelines.
- Improve performance and Core Web Vitals through image optimization, code splitting, and modern Next.js App Router patterns.

Website: https://klakar.com/

### Dizivizi — Frontend Developer (2024 — 2025, Remote, India)

Worked on the frontend of Dizivizi, a video-sharing platform where users tag videos to map locations so others can discover content by place. Built and maintained responsive UI, interactive map experiences, and dynamic video player interfaces for web.

- Implemented interactive map-based video discovery UI using React and JavaScript.
- Built responsive video player and listing components across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.
- Integrated backend APIs for video upload, geotagging, and feed rendering with clean loading and error states.

Website: https://dizivizi.com/
